verdict.rationale: Neon's evidence pack documents OLTP-oriented Postgres features (branching, autoscaling, read replicas, connection pooling, pgvector) but contains no evidence of columnar storage, OLAP query acceleration, materialized views, or any benchmark showing fast aggregation over large tables for dashboard workloads. Community commentary even raises latency concerns from Neon's storage/compute separation, but nothing directly confirms or denies dashboard-scale aggregation performance, so this is unevidenced rather than a documented failure.
